payload.title: Reconstruct structural evidence from test-available logs
payload.statement: Explicit typewell/horizontal GR alignment, particle filtering, and whole-well trellis inference can recover part of the missing structural-position signal using only MD, X, Y, Z, GR, TVT_input, and typewell TVT/GR.
payload.evidence_for: Frozen E005 particle filtering improved pooled RMSE from E004 15.4913063983 to 15.3502040715, reduced maximum well RMSE to 59.7754 and worst-5% SSE share to 0.3332, and had residual correlation 0.897248 to E004.
payload.evidence_against: The raw PF path raised p90 to 23.4851836927, won only 3 of 5 repeated maps, and regressed the worst spatial and typewell-cluster groups by 0.754215 and 0.185681 RMSE. Affine and trellis candidates did not beat E004.
payload.next_test: Do not promote or package raw E005 paths. Pre-register H009/E006 to test PF-E004 fusion and disagreement evidence with fresh nested or cross-fit placement and the same tail and shift gates.
